components.name: Alpha Keycap
components.css: .ds-key{--cap:#fcfbff;--ink:#25193f;--skirt:#c2b7da;background:var(--cap);color:var(--ink);border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.7),0 4px 0 var(--skirt),0 8px 12px -2px rgb(60 30 90/.28);transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.35),box-shadow 120ms;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Unbounded Variable',sans-serif;font-size:24px;min-width:64px;height:64px}.ds-key:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-key:active{background:var(--color-accent,#c81c71);color:#fcfbff;transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #8e024d,0 2px 4px -1px rgb(60 30 90/.28);}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c81c71;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: agney.dev is a mechanical keyboard built in Agney's own colorway, called Clack. The home page is the board itself; every other page is built from the same parts: plates, keycaps, wells, and legends.
keyCharacteristics: A four-role colorway: lilac plate, teal modifiers, pressed pink, lemon highlights.
Unbounded legends over Atkinson Hyperlegible Next body.
Keyboard first, with switchable single-key shortcuts.

rules.name: The Pressed Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink belongs only to the key that is pressed or active.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: No grey and no pure black. Every neutral is tinted from the plate's plum hue.

rules.name: The Unit Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy on the board comes from keycap width on a fixed unit ramp, not extra type sizes.

rules.name: The Travel Rule
rules.body: The zero-blur shadow is only ever a keycap's wall, always paired with a blurred cast shadow, always collapsing on press.

dos: Do build every control as a keycap or a well, with real travel.
Do keep pink for the pressed or active state only.
Do keep long-form reading quiet: ink on plate, Atkinson at 68ch.
Do give every motion a prefers-reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't use grey or pure black; tint from the plum hue.
Don't use a zero-blur shadow on anything that is not a keycap.
Don't add eyebrow labels, numbered section markers, or side-stripe borders.
Don't set body copy in Unbounded or mono.
Don't load fonts from a CDN.
